title: Improve overseer escalation, autonomous issue filing, and host->overseer migration
summary: Architecture for three coupled threads landing in a single PR (per HITL decision-22): (1) tighten the deployed agent-side overseer's escalation triggers via a Haiku-classify -> Opus-advisor gate (Anthropic 'advisor strategy' shape, two-call pattern -- see SDK capability spike below), (2) lift the issue-filing prohibition and add a shadow-mode autonomous GitHub-issue filing path (advisor recommends, human approves via existing pending_decisions HITL), (3) migrate stall / silent-agent / NACK / long-running-phase / stuck-pipeline-rescue logic out of the host-side /sdlc skill into the overseer so /sdlc becomes a thin reporter. All 23 HITL decisions are resolved. The SDK capability spike (decision-23 / Option C) decisively resolves to Option B (two-call advisor pattern): claude-agent-sdk 0.1.65 exposes 'advisor' only as a server-side message-parsing block, not as a client-side tool definition or max_uses parameter.

problem_statement.description: The deployed agent-side overseer (sandbox/agent-config/rules/overseer.md, sandbox/overseer_monitor.py) is 'pretty good' at escalating to humans via OVERSEER_ALERT but exhibits three coupled gaps: (1) escalation reliability -- false-positives during legitimate research time and on stale post-restart contract state; (2) no autonomous GitHub-issue filing -- explicitly forbidden at overseer.md:206 even though the underlying plumbing exists in orchestrator/overseer/issue_filer.py with one in-process caller (orchestrator/overseer/monitor.py:624) but no production instantiation; (3) host-side /sdlc skill (skills/sdlc/SKILL.md:489-639, 1359-1383) duplicates mid-pipeline debugging logic (3-min stall, 10-min silent agent, 3-min NACK, 60-min long-running phase, stuck-pipeline rescue, in-memory {role:{phase, phase_entered_at, nudged_at, first_seen_at, has_any_messages}} state map) that should now live in the overseer.
goals: Replace blanket Sonnet-decide with a Haiku-classify -> Opus-advisor gate (two-call pattern) bounded by an intersection trigger (Haiku confidence > threshold AND Tier-1 health alert present) per decision-18

Allow the overseer to autonomously compose and -- in shadow mode (decision-10) -- propose GitHub-issue filings, with the actual gh issue create gated on a human HITL decision surfaced through the existing pending_decisions flow (decision-21)

Migrate stall / silent-agent / NACK / long-running-phase / stuck-pipeline-rescue / AskUserQuestion side-flow logic from /sdlc into the overseer (decision-11), persisting cross-cycle agent-timing state in .egg-state/oversight/agent-timing.json (decision-16) and dedup state in .egg-state/oversight/filed-issues.json (decision-6)
Make wall-clock thresholds per-pipeline configurable via PipelineConfig (decision-12) so calibration can happen without code edits; bump stuck-phase-transition default to ~180s per feedback-1.Q2
Ship as a single PR (decision-22) with comprehensive tests across orchestrator/, sandbox/, gateway/, integration_tests/
non_goals: Sub-agent launching by the overseer -- deferred to #2000 per decision-2
Fixing #1722 (stale AGENT_FAILED) and #1727 (early-exit respawn) -- they stay in their own pipelines per decision-3
Coordination with #1806 (deployment-diagnose / agent-diagnose overlap) -- proceed independently per decision-13
Per-role PATH restructuring (#1786) -- add gateway allowlist now, defer PATH work per decision-14
Setting an advisor budget cap -- no cap for now; a separate follow-up issue will track budget per decision-19
Creating new GitHub labels (egg:diagnostic, pipeline-health, overseer-alert, overseer-opened) -- existing agent:overseer + p0/p1/p2/p3 only per decision-7/decision-17

recommended_approach.summary: Ship a single PR that (1) replaces the deployed overseer's blanket Sonnet-decide call with an intersection-gated two-call advisor pattern (Haiku classify -> Opus advisor when gate fires), (2) adds shadow-mode autonomous issue filing via a new `egg-orch overseer file-issue` CLI verb that runs `gh issue create` ITSELF inside the sandbox via the gateway (per decision-9 opt-1 -- CORRECTED from v1 which incorrectly routed through an orchestrator endpoint), with gateway allow-rule + label injection + size limits and a human-gated HITL flow on top of the existing pending_decisions surface, and (3) migrates host-side debugging logic into the overseer with persistent state in .egg-state/oversight/{filed-issues.jsonl,agent-timing.json} (CORRECTED: filed-issues is JSONL append-only; agent-timing is a single JSON object), AND keeps a concrete overseer-absent safety net in /sdlc as a last-resort tripwire (sized as a deliverable in component_breakdown, not just risk-mitigation prose).
key_design_choices: Two-call advisor pattern (decision-23 -> Option B per spike). overseer_decision_maker_model existing knob (default 'sonnet') is renamed conceptually to 'advisor model' with new default 'opus' via a fresh overseer_advisor_model knob; the existing Sonnet-decide flow becomes the advisor-invoke flow.

Intersection trigger gate (decision-18). Advisor invoked iff: Haiku confidence > 0.8 AND at least one Tier-1 health alert is present in the latest /api/v1/pipelines/{id}/health/alerts response. Both signals are already collected by overseer_monitor.py --once.

Distilled prompt contract (decision-20). Haiku passes the advisor: classification dict (type, confidence, reasoning) + last N=10 progress events + active health alerts list + last K=50 container log lines (fetched via existing get_container_logs MCP tool when needed). Concrete schema lives in sandbox/agent-config/rules/overseer.md as a new 'Advisor invocation' section.

Shadow-mode advisor recommendation (decision-21 + decision-10). Advisor returns one of: {alert_only, file_issue_recommended} with title, body, dedup_signature, priority, reasoning. When file_issue_recommended, the overseer wraps the recommendation in an OVERSEER_ALERT with detail.recommendation='file_issue' AND creates a HITL decision via mcp__sdlc__register_open_question with options ['File now', 'Skip', 'Modify and file']. The human resolves via the existing /sdlc pending_decisions flow; on 'File now', the overseer-agent receives the answer via mcp__sdlc__check_hitl_answers and runs `egg-orch overseer file-issue` which invokes gh through the gateway.

Per-repo dedup (decision-5 + decision-6). Overseer searches `gh issue list --label agent:overseer --state open` filtered by the dedup_signature in the issue body before requesting human approval; if a live match exists, suppress the recommendation entirely. Persist filed signatures to .egg-state/oversight/filed-issues.json (which the agent CAN write per OVERSEER_PATTERNS) for cross-cycle / cross-phase memory.

Labels (decision-7 + decision-17). gh issue create receives ONLY --label agent:overseer --label p<priority>. The DIAGNOSTIC_LABELS constant in orchestrator/overseer/issue_filer.py is updated. The gateway auto-injects these labels (per feedback-1.Q4) so the overseer cannot omit them or add unauthorized labels.

Issue body template (decision-8). Extend the existing _build_issue_body template at orchestrator/overseer/issue_filer.py:86-107 with explicit links section: pipeline ID, phase, branch, commit SHA (from current HEAD), parent OVERSEER_ALERT message ID. Existing sections (Anomaly, Timeline, Classification, Actions, Suggested Remediation) are preserved.

Host migration (decision-11 + decision-16). Move the {role:{phase, phase_entered_at, nudged_at, first_seen_at, has_any_messages}} state map into the overseer agent, persisted to .egg-state/oversight/agent-timing.json so it survives phase transitions and overseer respawns. Migrate stall (3-min) / silent-agent (10-min) / NACK-escalation (3-min) / long-running-phase (60-min) / stuck-pipeline-rescue logic into the overseer's loop. Migrate the 'Check agent logs' / 'Nudge agent' / 'Restart pipeline' AskUserQuestion side flows into overseer-initiated actions: the overseer fetches container logs proactively via get_container_logs and embeds findings in OVERSEER_ALERT.detail; nudges become STATUS messages the overseer sends directly per the existing overseer.md:131-141 allowed peer-message rule; restarts surface as OVERSEER_ALERT recommendations the human approves via HITL.

PipelineConfig wall-clock thresholds (decision-12 + feedback-1.Q2). New overseer_stuck_phase_transition_seconds (default 180, bumped from 60), overseer_stall_threshold_seconds (default 180), overseer_silent_agent_threshold_seconds (default 600), overseer_long_running_phase_threshold_seconds (default 3600), overseer_nack_escalation_threshold_seconds (default 180) -- all surfaced via PipelineConfig and read by the agent through GET /api/v1/pipelines/{id}/status (already returns config block).

Gateway policy (decision-14 + feedback-1.Q4). Remove `issue create` from _OVERSEER_BLOCKED_GH_OPS for the OVERSEER role only, but add an explicit allow-rule that (a) auto-injects --label agent:overseer --label p<priority> and rejects any user-supplied additional labels, (b) enforces --title <= 120 chars, (c) enforces --body <= 50 KB, (d) restricts --repo to the pipeline's own repo (read from current EGG_PIPELINE_REPO env). NO rate-limit per feedback-1.Q4. PATH restructuring deferred to #1786.

Lift the prohibition (overseer.md:206). Replace the line 'the human will file it -- you do not file issues yourself' with the new advisor-recommends-human-gates flow doc; preserve the spirit by making the actual file-issue gated on a HITL decision in shadow mode.

output_schema.issue_title: string (<= 120 chars, only present when decision=file_issue_recommended)
output_schema.issue_body: string (<= 50 KB, only present when decision=file_issue_recommended)

execution_flow_per_cycle: 1. overseer_monitor.py --once collects status/alerts/progress/messages/consensus -> JSON line. (For infra-error fast classification, the agent calls shared.egg_overseer_helpers.infra_error.classify_infra_error on raw error text BEFORE LLM dispatch; this can short-circuit the cycle without invoking Haiku at all.)
2. Agent rule: parse JSON, build Haiku prompt, call run_agent_async(model='haiku', max_turns=1) -> classification dict
3. Gate check: if classification.confidence > overseer_advisor_haiku_confidence_threshold (default 0.8) AND len(tier1_alerts) > 0 -> proceed to step 4; else go to step 6
4. Build advisor prompt with the distilled-summary contract; call run_agent_async(model=overseer_advisor_model='claude-opus-4-20250514', max_turns=1) -> advisor result dict

5. Branch on advisor.decision: 'alert_only' -> egg-orch overseer alert with {priority, summary, detail}; 'file_issue_recommended' -> (a) check .egg-state/oversight/filed-issues.jsonl for matching dedup_signature -> if hit, emit alert_only-equivalent only; (b) else egg-orch overseer alert (with detail.recommendation='file_issue') + register HITL decision via mcp__sdlc__register_open_question with options ['File now', 'Skip', 'Modify and file']; on next cycle, mcp__sdlc__check_hitl_answers; on 'File now' -> agent invokes `egg-orch overseer file-issue --signature --title --body-file

--priority --parent-alert-msg-id ` which (sandbox-side, via gateway): runs `gh issue list --label agent:overseer --search ` for live-state dedup re-check; if no hit, runs `gh issue create --title --body-file

--label agent:overseer --label p`; on success appends a JSONL record to .egg-state/oversight/filed-issues.jsonl
6. If gate didn't fire and prior alert is unresolved past overseer_max_cycles_before_re_alert (3), re-emit at bumped priority (existing behavior preserved)

component_breakdown.component: egg-orch overseer file-issue CLI verb (sandbox-side, agent-mode opt-1)
component_breakdown.spec: egg-orch overseer file-issue --signature --title --body-file <path> --priority <p0|p1|p2|p3> --parent-alert-msg-id <id> [--dry-run] [--json]. Mirrors the alert subcommand's parser shape (lines 2555-2597). Per decision-9 opt-1, this CLI runs ENTIRELY INSIDE THE SANDBOX: it (a) reads .egg-state/oversight/filed-issues.json to check the local dedup signature; (b) shells out to `gh issue list --label agent:overseer --state open --search <signature-marker> --json number,body` to verify against the live GitHub state; (c) on no-dedup, builds the body via the agent-side helper that imports the body template (see component below) and shells out to `gh issue create --title <t> --body-file <p> --label agent:overseer --label p<priority>`; (d) on success, appends a JSONL record to .egg-state/oversight/filed-issues.json. The gateway mediates the underlying gh invocations -- there is NO orchestrator-side endpoint that runs gh. The orchestrator is uninvolved in the gh call itself; it only sees the resulting OVERSEER_ALERT and HITL decision messages the agent sends through normal BRC channels.

Pure-Python helper (NO orchestrator dependency, NO REST calls) used by the new `egg-orch overseer file-issue` CLI. Imports the existing template from orchestrator/overseer/issue_filer.py:_build_issue_body OR re-implements the same template inline (to avoid cross-cutting import from sandbox to orchestrator/). Adds the new explicit-links section per decision-8: pipeline ID, phase, branch (from `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD`), commit SHA (from `git rev-parse HEAD`), parent OVERSEER_ALERT message ID (passed as --parent-alert-msg-id arg). Exposes build_issue_body(pipeline_id, phase, agent_role, anomaly: dict, context: dict, parent_alert_msg_id: str, branch: str, commit_sha: str) -> str.

component_breakdown.filed_issues_format: JSON Lines (.jsonl) -- one JSON object per line; no top-level wrapper. Chosen for unbounded append-only growth, atomic O_APPEND writes, and cheap age-based eviction by line-level filtering. The schema_version is encoded as a special first-line header record `{"_kind": "header", "schema_version": 1}` so writers/readers can detect format drift without a sidecar file.
component_breakdown.filed_issues_record_schema: {signature: str, issue_number: int, filed_at: ISO8601, pipeline_id: str, anomaly_type: str, priority: str, parent_alert_msg_id: str}
component_breakdown.agent_timing_format: Single JSON object (.json) -- read AND rewritten on every overseer cycle so atomic full-file rewrite (write tmp + rename) is the right semantics here. NOT JSONL because the data is by-role state with frequent updates, not append-only events.
component_breakdown.agent_timing_schema: { schema_version: 1, pipeline_id: str, current_phase: str, roles: { <role>: {phase: str, phase_entered_at: ISO8601, nudged_at: ISO8601 | null, first_seen_at: ISO8601, has_any_messages: bool} } }
component_breakdown.writer: sandbox/overseer_monitor.py helpers: O_APPEND + fsync for filed-issues.jsonl; tmp + rename for agent-timing.json. Reader: agent rule loop. Eviction: drop filed-issues.jsonl lines older than 30 days at NEXT-write time (the writer reads, filters, rewrites the whole file once per day -- eviction is therefore a periodic compaction, NOT a per-write op; the typical write path remains O_APPEND).

NEW: 'Overseer-absent safety net' section -- concrete deliverable. TRIGGER: every host-side event-loop tick, compute (a) count of OVERSEER_ALERT messages received this phase from message_store, (b) phase_elapsed_seconds. If count == 0 AND phase_elapsed_seconds > 2 * overseer_stall_threshold_seconds (default 360s = 2 * 180s) AND running_agents is non-empty, the host falls back to a minimal stall check: emit one AskUserQuestion with options ['Wait', 'Check container health (via mcp__progress__query_status)', 'Cancel pipeline'] and an info banner explaining the overseer appears unhealthy or disabled. The fallback check fires AT MOST ONCE per phase to avoid noise. Implementation hooks: read overseer_max_respawns from PipelineConfig to detect the case where respawn limit was exhausted. The fallback does NOT re-implement the full stall/NACK/long-run detection -- it only provides a single tripwire so a runaway pipeline doesn't go unnoticed when the overseer is absent.

technical_decisions.decision: Intersection trigger gate (decision-18) -- advisor invoked only when Haiku confidence > 0.8 AND >= 1 Tier-1 health alert is present
technical_decisions.rationale: Matches the #2012 precedent that fixed agent-heartbeat-stall false positives. Both signals are already collected by overseer_monitor.py --once; no new infrastructure. feedback-1.Q1 directly identifies false-positive classes (research-time heartbeat-stall, stale-state stuck-phase-transition) that this gate eliminates.

technical_decisions.decision: Distilled prompt contract (decision-20) -- classification + last 10 progress events + active health alerts + last 50 container log lines
technical_decisions.rationale: Bounds advisor token cost predictably; lets us monotonically expand context if accuracy proves insufficient. Reviewer note in the analysis (decision-20 line 695-698) flagged the Option B alternative 'classification + pointer'; the human selected the richer distilled summary, so we ship that. Token budget per call: estimated ~3-5K input tokens at p95.

technical_decisions.decision: Advisor recommends, human gates the actual file (decision-21) -- advisor returns decision=file_issue_recommended; overseer surfaces a HITL decision via mcp__sdlc__register_open_question with options ['File now', 'Skip', 'Modify and file']
technical_decisions.rationale: Matches shadow-mode rollout (decision-10). Reuses the existing pending_decisions flow + provide_input plumbing; zero new HITL channel per feedback-1.Q7.

technical_decisions.decision: Per-repo dedup with .egg-state/oversight/filed-issues.json + gh issue list verification (decision-5 + decision-6)
technical_decisions.rationale: Local file = fast cross-cycle / cross-phase memory survives overseer respawn (phase-scoped lifetime per overseer.md:5). gh issue list = authoritative against externally-closed / human-edited issues. The combination matches decision-6 opt-2 + the natural verification step. OVERSEER_PATTERNS already permits .egg-state/oversight/, so no file-boundary work (decision-15 = no-op).

technical_decisions.decision: Agent-side CLI verb runs `gh issue create` ITSELF inside the sandbox via the gateway (true decision-9 opt-1; v1 design INCORRECTLY routed through an orchestrator-side endpoint, which would have been opt-3 hybrid -- now FIXED). The CLI: (a) consults .egg-state/oversight/filed-issues.jsonl + `gh issue list --label agent:overseer --search <signature>` for dedup; (b) builds the issue body via the new sandbox/egg_lib/overseer_issue_body.py helper; (c) shells `gh issue create` through the gateway; (d) appends a JSONL record on success. NO orchestrator-side endpoint runs gh.
technical_decisions.rationale: Most agent-mode-friendly per decision-9. Reviewer correctly flagged the v1 design as architecturally inconsistent (server-side gh + gateway argv-rewrite mention) and as deviating from decision-9 opt-1; this revision restores the resolution. The gateway is the right policy boundary because it ALREADY mediates `gh` for refiners and coders; extending it to overseer issue-create reuses that machinery. The orchestrator only sees the resulting OVERSEER_ALERT/HITL messages on the BRC bus.

Three threads share the rule-doc edit and PipelineConfig knobs. Splitting forces coordinating commits on overseer.md across PRs and risks one half landing without the other. Review burden mitigated by a clean component split in the PR description.

technical_decisions.decision: PipelineConfig-driven thresholds (decision-12 + feedback-1.Q2) -- bump stuck-phase-transition default to 180s; all migrated wall-clock thresholds become PipelineConfig fields
technical_decisions.rationale: Per-pipeline override enables calibration without code edits. Default 180s for stuck-phase-transition addresses the false positive class observed during this very pipeline's refine phase (refiner read source files for ~3.5 min legitimately).

technical_decisions.decision: Gateway label injection + size limits + repo restriction (feedback-1.Q4) -- when the OVERSEER role invokes `gh issue create`, the gateway argv-rewrite helper enforces (a) auto-injection of --label agent:overseer + --label p<priority>, (b) --title <= 120 chars, (c) --body / --body-file content <= 50 KB, (d) --repo restricted to env EGG_PIPELINE_REPO. Argv rewrite delta logged at INFO level. Reviewer non-blocking item correctly noted that `gh issue create` is currently blocked by the unknown-operation default-deny pattern from #1494 (NOT by an entry in _OVERSEER_BLOCKED_GH_OPS); the planner's task is to add an EXPLICIT ALLOW (early-return or new _OVERSEER_ALLOWED_GH_OPS set) -- see the EGG_PIPELINE_REPO env-injection verification component for the env dependency.
technical_decisions.rationale: Defense-in-depth: even if the agent's prompt drifts and tries to add stray labels or post to a different repo, the gateway catches it. NO rate-limit per feedback-1.Q4; dedup + shadow-mode is the rate control. The EGG_PIPELINE_REPO dependency is sized as a separate verify-and-inject task in component_breakdown.

technical_decisions.decision: Migrate side-flow AskUserQuestion options ('Check agent logs' / 'Nudge agent' / 'Restart pipeline') into overseer-initiated actions (feedback-1.Q5)
technical_decisions.rationale: Matches the 'host is a thin reporter' end-state. 'Check agent logs' becomes proactive get_container_logs in the overseer's loop with findings in OVERSEER_ALERT.detail. 'Nudge agent' becomes a STATUS message the overseer sends directly per overseer.md:131-141. 'Restart pipeline' becomes a HITL recommendation (advisor-flagged restart_recommended) the human approves.
Phase-scoped overseer lifetime requires this to survive respawn / phase transition. OVERSEER_PATTERNS already permits .egg-state/oversight/ so no file-boundary work needed.

technical_decisions.decision: Mark orchestrator/overseer/{monitor,classifier,decision_maker}.py paths DEAD CODE in this PR (skip-marker tests; module-header docstring; follow-up issue for full removal). technical_decisions.rationale: These deterministic patterns encode hard-won incident knowledge. Re-implementing them in the agent-side advisor prompt would lose the precision and require LLM inference for what is a matter of regex matching. The shared/ location ensures one source of truth -- the orchestrator side imports it before being marked dead, the agent side imports it from inside the sandbox container (sandbox already imports from shared/egg_logging per overseer_monitor.py).

/sdlc skill stripping host-side detection logic depends on the overseer being deployed and healthy -- if the overseer respawn-loops (overseer_max_respawns=3 limit reached) or is disabled, host loses safety net. Mitigation: the new 'Overseer-absent safety net' addition in the /sdlc skill component-breakdown SPECS the fallback as a deliverable (count==0 alerts AND elapsed > 2 * overseer_stall_threshold_seconds AND running_agents non-empty -> single AskUserQuestion; fires AT MOST ONCE per phase). This is now in component_breakdown additions, not just risk-mitigation prose.

Two-call advisor pattern doubles network round-trips per advisor invocation (Haiku then Opus) -- p95 latency budget for the overseer cycle goes from one round trip to two. Default poll interval (30s) absorbs this comfortably but any tightening of poll_interval below ~10s risks overlapping cycles.

Gateway label injection rewrites the gh argv the agent submitted -- agent-side audit logs may show different content than what was actually invoked. The component_breakdown gateway entry now mandates INFO-level logging of the argv-rewrite delta for forensic reproducibility.

PipelineConfig default bumped from 60s to 180s for stuck-phase-transition could mask other genuine stalls in pipelines that historically completed faster. Mitigation: emit a one-time INFO log on default-vs-custom threshold so operators can see what's effective.

Persisted .egg-state/oversight/filed-issues.jsonl grows append-only. Mitigation: format is JSON Lines (per the corrected component_breakdown schema) so per-write cost is O(1); a periodic compaction (read all, drop entries older than 30 days, atomic rewrite) runs at most once per UTC day. The atomic-write semantics for compaction are tmp + rename; the typical write path is O_APPEND + fsync. THIS IS A CORRECTION to the v1 schema that conflated single-JSON-doc with append-only semantics.

Token-budget for the advisor call (distilled summary) is currently estimated at 3-5K input tokens at p95 in td-3 but is UNVERIFIED -- with 50 container log lines + 10 progress events + N health alerts + classification, real-world content could push this to 5-10K depending on log line length. The risk_analyst should size this properly under decision-19's 'no cap for now' resolution so the follow-up budget-tracking issue has measured baseline data. Mandatory cost-tracking telemetry (already in metrics_for_success.instrumentation.token_usage) gives that data on day 1.

architect_resolved_questions.question: Q1 -- delete vs mark-unused for orchestrator/overseer/{decision_maker,classifier,monitor}.py?
architect_resolved_questions.resolution: MARK UNUSED IN THIS PR. Three reasons: (1) Deleting expands the PR diff materially (~2.6k LOC across 3 files + their ~200+ tests) which conflicts with decision-22's single-PR cohesion goal; the migration is already large. (2) decision_maker.py contains _is_restartable + RESTARTABLE_PATTERNS / NON_RESTARTABLE_PATTERNS which we explicitly want to PRESERVE (extracted into shared/egg_overseer_helpers/infra_error.py per the new infra-error-helper component); deleting decision_maker.py breaks the import path during PR-review until reviewers see the extraction. (3) The corresponding tests in orchestrator/tests/test_overseer_*.py give us a regression net during the migration -- if the agent-side advisor regresses behavior the dead-code path used to encode, having those tests around (even marked unused / not run) gives planners a reference the new agent-side prompt can be diff'd against. ACTION: in this PR, add `# DEAD CODE -- see decision-9; live filing/escalation path is sandbox-side` module headers + a top-level pytest skip on the test files (or move them to orchestrator/tests/_dead_code/ with skip markers). FILE A FOLLOW-UP issue 'remove dead orchestrator-side overseer code' that the post-migration cleanup issue lands.

architect_resolved_questions.question: Q3 -- overseer_advisor_model default: alias or pinned?
architect_resolved_questions.resolution: PINNED to claude-opus-4-20250514 (the current latest Opus 4 generation). Documented in the rule doc. Operators can override via PipelineConfig per-pipeline.
